compute_predicted_aligned_error: compute predicted aligned error and confidence metrics from logits tensor output of PredictedAlignedErrorHead
compute_tm: compute predicted TM-score from logits tensor with optional residue weights and bin parameters
calculate_bin_centers: calculate bin centers from alignment confidence boundaries for error probability binning
calculate_expected_aligned_error: calculate expected aligned distance error from probability distributions over error bins
run_loss_computation: run protein structure alignment loss and confidence score computation from model logits
